title: slam_toolbox "Failed to compute odom pose" in ROS 2: base_frame mismatch, ignored launch argument and silent drops, measured
excerpt: What triggers slam_toolbox's "Failed to compute odom pose" and what fails silently instead: base_frame defaulting to base_footprint, base_frame:= ignored on the launch line, two tf parents, missing or late odometry, and ros2 run on Jazzy. 24 cases on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
